I want to see the #PS5 as much as the next guy, but @PlayStation have absolutely made the right move here. I'd even admit I wouldn't have thought of it. 

I'd personally tie it to the inevitable delays that'll happen because of #Coronavirus but well done for letting #BLM breath.

If @Starbucks has opted for neutrality in these times by not letting staff show their support for #BlackLivesMatter they better not change a thing when Gay Pride comes around.
We're literally telling you that double standards is an issue, so you better stay neutral for all of it.
